file_basepath.description: Base path for file-based metric storage (ignored for non-file drivers).

redis_host.description: Redis server hostname (used if storage driver is 'redis').

redis_port.description: Redis server port (used if storage driver is 'redis').

redis_db.description: Redis database number (used if storage driver is 'redis').

elasticsearch_url.description: Comma-separated Elasticsearch URLs (used if storage driver is 'elasticsearch').

elasticsearch_number_of_shards.description: Number of shards per Elasticsearch index.

elasticsearch_number_of_replicas.description: Number of replicas per Elasticsearch index.

ceph_conffile.description: Path to Ceph configuration file (used if storage driver is 'ceph').

ceph_pool.description: Ceph pool name for metric storage.

elasticsearch_verify_ssl.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates for Elasticsearch.

metricd_workers.description: Number of worker processes for metric ingestion and processing.

metric_processing_timeout.description: Maximum seconds a metric processing worker may run before timeout.

metrics_per_batch.description: Maximum number of metrics processed per batch.

metrics_queue_max.description: Maximum number of metrics queued before backpressure is applied.

retry_attempts.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed operations.

log_level.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

keystone_username.description: Service user name for Gnocchi in Keystone.

keystone_password.description: Password for the Gnocchi service user in Keystone.

indexer_url.description: Database connection URL for metadata indexing (e.g., SQLAlchemy URL).

removed.description: Removed `enable_ingestion` because it is not a documented directive in the gnocchi-metricd man page.
